# Toyota_Booking_Changes_Agent: journey 06, "Confirm, change or cancel a booking".
# Finds an existing service booking, then confirms it, moves it to another day or time, moves it
# to another centre, adds a job to it, or cancels it.
# Style: deterministic FLOW. Every question to the caller is one short reasoning step that stores
# the answer and sets step_outcome; every lookup, branch, counter and write is a fixed step.
# Covers: E90 E91 E92 E93 E94 E95 E126 E96 E97 E98 E99 P12 P13 Q07 A04 Q06 E100 E102
#   E90   known caller with a future booking: found on the profile, mentioned, caller asked whether to keep or change it
#   E91   several future bookings: asks which car, without listing them
#   E92   unknown number: booking reference first (the DBM or service order number on the SMS), then plate and phone
#   E93   booked on WhatsApp, the website or at the branch: one lookup with no channel filter finds every channel
#   E94   forgot they already booked: the same lookup, then the offer to move it
#   E95   OPEN booking in someone else's name: a person (flag TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_THIRD_PARTY_ALLOWED)
#   E126  OPEN calls to confirm: reads back date, time and centre, resends the confirmation if asked (flag TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_CONFIRM_READBACK)
#   E96   date or time change: updates the same booking with a held slot
#   E97   centre change: replaces the booking in one call to the booking system, which makes the new booking and cancels the old one together
#   E98   nothing new suits: the current booking is kept
#   E99   "can I do it myself": the link in the confirmation message
#   P12   add a job: added if the booking system allows it, otherwise a person
#   P13   OPEN missed or running late: the next free slot, then another day; a booking missed today is found, one missed earlier needs a new booking (flag TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_LATE_NOTIFY_CENTRE)
#   Q07   OPEN change or cancel on the day: done; only the booking system can say a booking is past changing (flag TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_SAME_DAY_ALLOWED)
#   A04   changes are made in the booking system itself; anything it cannot change goes to a person
#   Q06   OPEN cancel or reschedule (Q06 is also E100): another date is offered first, then the reason is asked and recorded; a cancellation is confirmed by message
#   E102  OPEN cancelling a recall booking: the recall team is told (flag TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_RECALL_CANCEL_NOTIFY)
# Rules reused from journey 05, owned by the service booking agent: holiday list before any slot
# (N02), live slots only and the read-back format (E78), up to three options (Q05), the picked slot
# is held and a lost slot is searched once more (E85), plate read back twice at most (E55).
# Entered by the supervisor (intent booking_change) and by the outbound agent on a reminder call,
# which passes the booking reference. identity_status "unknown" on entry means the calling number
# is not on file and nobody has been asked anything: the booking is found as E92 says and the
# caller is treated as a guest.
# This agent closes its own turn: a finished task ends with the shared line anything_else.
# Environment flags read here. Each default is the interim behaviour of the use-case document:
#   TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_THIRD_PARTY_ALLOWED   default "false". "true": a booking in someone else's name may be changed here (E95)
#   TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_CONFIRM_READBACK      default "true".  "false": calls to confirm a booking go to a person (E126)
#   TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_SAME_DAY_ALLOWED      default "true".  "false": a change or cancellation on the day of the booking goes to a person (Q07)
#   TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_LATE_NOTIFY_CENTRE    default "false". "true": the service centre is told when a late caller keeps the booking (P13)
#   TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_RECALL_CANCEL_NOTIFY  default "true".  "false": the recall team is not told when a recall booking is cancelled (E102)
AGENT: Toyota_Booking_Changes_Agent
VERSION: "0.2.0"
DESCRIPTION: "Finds an existing Toyota service booking and confirms it, moves it to another time or centre, adds a job to it or cancels it"

GOAL: |
  Find the caller's existing Toyota service booking and do exactly what they ask with it:
  confirm it, move it to another day or time, move it to another service centre, add a job
  to it, or cancel it. Use what is already known about the caller and the car, change
  nothing before the caller has clearly said yes, and hand anything that is not about an
  existing service booking back to the supervisor.

PERSONA: |
  You are the Toyota voice assistant for Al-Futtaim in the UAE, looking after an existing
  service booking. Warm, brief and exact. You ask one short question at a time, you repeat
  dates, times and numbers back clearly, and you never rush a caller into a change.

LIMITATIONS:
  - "Never change, move or cancel a booking, or add a job to it, before the caller has clearly said yes to exactly that."
  - "Only say booking details, times and centres that the current step gives you from the live system. Never invent a time, a centre, a reference or a fee."
  - "Never list the caller's cars or bookings, never read a booking out before the step gives you its details, and never mention a profile or another brand."
  - "Never take or promise an email. Confirmations go by message only."
  - "Never quote a price or the final bill, never say how long the service will take, and never confirm warranty cover."
  - "Never name agents, systems, tools, flags or routing to the caller."
  - "Safety comes first. If the car may not be safe to drive, or the caller says roadside, accident, injury, or a child or pet locked in the car, stop the booking work and raise it as the step tells you."
  - "A request that is not about an existing service booking is never declined: it is handed back with __return_to_parent__."
  - "Do not greet and do not replay a welcome. When the task is done a fixed step asks whether there is anything else: never add that question, an offer of more help or a goodbye yourself."

LANGUAGE: "en"

# max_flow_iterations is the documented platform default, stated because this flow branches
# with many small fixed steps and one guide quotes a lower default.
EXECUTION:
  temperature: 0.1
  max_reasoning_iterations: 4
  max_flow_iterations: 1500
  tool_timeout: 8000

# The toyota_voice profile owns the whole CONVERSATION block (tone, two sentences, language,
# barge-in, silence): this agent declares none of it.
USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: toyota_voice
USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: ai_summit_demo

# E99 and the standing rules for every reasoning step. Each step goal repeats the short form.
INSTRUCTIONS: |
  You work one small step at a time. The step goal tells you what to ask and what to store.
  - Ask one short question, listen, store the answer in the fields the step names, set
    step_outcome to one of the values the step lists, and say nothing more in that turn. The
    next step speaks. Only write the fields the step names.
  - Write the fields and step_outcome in the same update. If you cannot, write step_outcome
    last: the step ends as soon as step_outcome is set.
  - Never ask for something the caller has already said in this call, and never ask who is calling.
  - When a step starts, the caller's last words answered the previous question. For a yes or no,
    or a choice, only an answer given after you asked this step's question counts.
  - Say dates as weekday, day and month with the time, for example "Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm".
    The time of a booking and every free time are given to you in those words: say them as they
    are given, in the caller's language, and never work out their weekday yourself.
    If the caller says a weekday that is also today's weekday, ask whether they mean today or next week.
  - A booking reference is read back one character at a time. A phone number the caller has just
    given is read back in groups of three or four digits. Wait for a yes before you store either.
  - If the caller asks whether they can change or cancel the booking themselves: yes, with the link
    in the confirmation message. Offer to send that message again, or to do it for them now.
  - No email. The confirmation message carries a link to add the booking to a calendar, reschedule,
    cancel or track it.
  - Jobs are added without a price. Do not quote a price or a duration: hand that question back
    with __return_to_parent__.
  - Safety: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
    problem, or says they are afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive. Safe and
    they only want it looked at: write it in concern_note and carry on. Not safe, unsure or afraid:
    write their words in safety_note and set step_outcome to "safety". Roadside, an accident, an
    injury, or a child or pet locked in the car: set step_outcome to "safety" at once and ask nothing.
  - A person: if the caller asks for a person, write two or three sentences in caller_note (who is
    calling, what they wanted, what was done, what is still needed) and set step_outcome to
    "person". If they ask for a manager or a supervisor, do the same with step_outcome "manager".
    If the caller is upset or complaining, do the same with step_outcome "upset".
  - A change of mind about this booking, in a step that lists the outcome "switch": write the
    new action in switch_action (confirm, resend, reschedule, late, change_centre, add_job,
    cancel, keep, other_booking or other_change) and set step_outcome to "switch". Before a
    booking has been found there is nothing to switch: carry on with the step.
  - Anything that is not about an existing service booking: hand the caller's request back with
    __return_to_parent__. Never decline it and never try to answer it.

# The runtime plays these while a tool call or a hand-off runs: no step speaks a hold line.
MESSAGES:
  filler_general: "One moment please."
  filler_general_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_tool_call: "One moment please."
  filler_tool_call_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_handoff: "One moment please."
  filler_handoff_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."

MEMORY:
  session:
    # Shared session contract: passed in by the supervisor, or by the outbound agent on a reminder call
    - NAME: caller_phone
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_status
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "unknown, matched, confirmed, guest, third_party or third_party_verified. unknown here means the calling number is not on file and nobody has been asked anything"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: crm_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "CRM profile the call is about. Empty for a guest"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: customer_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: caller_name
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The caller's own name as they gave it earlier in the call"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Number the confirmation message is sent to"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: plate_number
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_model
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_reference
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Service booking this call is about"
      READONLY: true
    # Escapes: the flags are set only by fixed steps, after the reason and the summary. They
    # start false again whenever this agent is entered or resumed, so a flag raised for an
    # earlier request can never send a later one away.
    - NAME: safety_flag
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: safety_note
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The safety concern in the caller's own words"
    - NAME: needs_person
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      RESET: per_activation
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_reason
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_summary
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_queue
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Queue for the person escape: toyota_service"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_detail
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    # Written by the reasoning steps
    - NAME: step_outcome
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Outcome of the current question. Use only a value the current step lists"
    - NAME: switch_action
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "New action when the caller changes their mind: confirm, resend, reschedule, late, change_centre, add_job, cancel, keep, other_booking or other_change"
    - NAME: caller_note
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Two or three sentences for the person taking over: who is calling, what they wanted, what was done, what is still needed"
    - NAME: concern_note
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "A concern about the car that is safe to drive, in English, for the service centre notes"
    - NAME: requested_action
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "What the caller wants done with the booking: confirm, resend, reschedule, late, change_centre, add_job, cancel, keep, other_booking or other_change"
    - NAME: lookup_reference
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Booking reference from the confirmation message: the DBM or service order number"
    - NAME: lookup_plate
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Plate number the caller said: emirate, code and number"
    - NAME: lookup_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Mobile number the booking was made with, international format such as +971501234567"
    - NAME: requested_date
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Day the caller wants, as YYYY-MM-DD"
    - NAME: preferred_time
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Exact time the caller asked for, 24-hour HH:MM"
    - NAME: window_start
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Start of the part of the day the caller asked for, 24-hour HH:MM"
    - NAME: window_end
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "End of the part of the day the caller asked for, 24-hour HH:MM"
    - NAME: chosen_slot_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Slot id of the time the caller accepted, copied from the list in the step"
    - NAME: change_reason_code
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Why the booking is moved: one of schedule_conflict, car_not_available, serviced_elsewhere, price, booked_twice, other"
    - NAME: change_reason_text
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The caller's reason for moving the booking, in their own words"
    - NAME: centre_place
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Centre, area or landmark the caller named for the new service centre"
    - NAME: centre_emirate
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Emirate the caller named, only when they said it"
    - NAME: chosen_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Centre id of the centre the caller accepted, copied from the list in the step"
    - NAME: jobs_to_add
      TYPE: array
      DESCRIPTION: "Jobs to add to the booking: a list of short English labels"
    - NAME: cancel_reason_code
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "One of schedule_conflict, car_not_available, serviced_elsewhere, price, booked_twice, other"
    - NAME: cancel_reason_text
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The caller's reason for cancelling, in their own words"
    - NAME: new_contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Different mobile number for the confirmation message, international format such as +971501234567"
    - NAME: message_language
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Language of the call for the message: en or ar"
    # Owned by the fixed steps: today in the UAE, read from the booking system's calendar
    - NAME: today_date
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Today's date in the UAE, YYYY-MM-DD"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: today_weekday
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Today's weekday in the UAE, in English"
      READONLY: true
    # Owned by the fixed steps: lookup
    - NAME: lookup_mode
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lookup_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: owner_only
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: profile_empty
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: another_booking
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_open
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_options
      TYPE: array
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: selected_booking
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: plate_try_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: which_car_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: restart_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: switch_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    # Owned by the fixed steps: the booking as it stands
    - NAME: current_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: current_centre_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: current_start_time
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: current_start_label
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Start of the booking in words, as the booking system gives it"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: current_service_label
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: current_service_code
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: current_status
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "confirmed, in_workshop or missed"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_date
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_can_change
      TYPE: boolean
      DESCRIPTION: "The booking system's answer to whether the booking can still be changed or cancelled"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_owner_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Customer profile the booking belongs to"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_has_pickup
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    # Owned by the fixed steps: the change being made
    - NAME: target_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: target_centre_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: centre_move
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: late_mode
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_round_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_retry_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: options_ran_out
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: centre_search_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: date_ok
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: closed_holiday
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: day_closed_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: day_closed_date
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: no_slot_date
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: day_needed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    # A tool result lives for one turn. What a later turn needs (the free times and the
    # centres being offered) is copied into these declared variables.
    - NAME: slot_options
      TYPE: array
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_options_date
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: centre_options
      TYPE: array
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_lost
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: picked_slot
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: held_hold_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Hold on the picked slot, passed to the booking system with the change"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: picked_centre
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: centre_none
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: job_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: caller_confirmed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: change_made
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: change_notes
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: replaced_booking_reference
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: replacement_contact_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: replacement_contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: replacement_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    # Staging value written by create_service_booking; booking_reference is set from it by a fixed step
    - NAME: new_booking_reference
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: refusal_reason
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Reason code the booking system gave when it refused a change, for the person taking over"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: late_fee_aed
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: cancel_was_recall
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    # Owned by the fixed steps: messages
    - NAME: contact_last_digits
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: sms_number_confirmed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: message_template
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "service_booking_confirmation or service_booking_cancellation"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: cancel_message
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: team_mobile
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: team_customer_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: team_summary
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true

TOOLS:
  find_service_bookings(customer_id?: string, plate_number?: string, mobile_number?: string, booking_reference?: string) -> {total: number, bookings: {booking_reference: string, plate_number: string, vehicle_model: string, centre_id: string, centre_name: string, start_time: string, start_label: string, minutes_until_start: number, can_change: boolean, service_code: string, service_label: string, extra_jobs: string[], notes: string, current_km: number, preferred_advisor: string, channel: string, status: string, customer_name: string, belongs_to_customer_id: string, booked_by_name: string, contact_name: string, contact_mobile: string, is_recall: boolean, pickup_dropoff: boolean}[]}
    description: "Find service bookings from every channel by booking reference, plate, mobile or customer. Returns bookings from the start of today, including a booking for a car that is in the workshop today and missed ones. status is one of confirmed (still to come), in_workshop (the car is at the centre today), missed (the time passed and the car did not come). Cancelled bookings, and bookings whose car has been collected, are not returned. All filters given must match; for a duplicate check pass the plate only. Use before booking to prevent a duplicate, before retrying a failed booking, and to find the booking a caller wants to confirm, change or cancel. start_label is the start time in words, for the read-back. minutes_until_start counts from now and is negative once the time has passed. can_change is true while the booking can still be changed or cancelled, per current policy. channel is one of phone, whatsapp, website, branch. customer_name and belongs_to_customer_id say whose booking it is; booked_by_name is the person who made it for them, or empty."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      customer_id:
        description: "Customer profile identifier from lookup_customer_by_phone or search_customer"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate of the car, as confirmed with the caller"
      mobile_number:
        description: "Mobile number on the booking, E.164"
      booking_reference:
        description: "Booking reference from the confirmation SMS: the DBM or service order number"
    process:
      before:
        require:
          - params.customer_id != "" || params.plate_number != "" || params.mobile_number != "" || params.booking_reference != ""
        on_fail: block("A booking reference, a plate, a mobile number or a customer is needed to find a booking.")
    on_result:
      set:
        existing_booking_count: result.total
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, bookings[].booking_reference, bookings[].plate_number, bookings[].vehicle_model, bookings[].centre_id, bookings[].centre_name, bookings[].start_time, bookings[].start_label, bookings[].minutes_until_start, bookings[].can_change, bookings[].service_code, bookings[].service_label, bookings[].extra_jobs, bookings[].preferred_advisor, bookings[].status, bookings[].booked_by_name, bookings[].is_recall, bookings[].pickup_dropoff]

  find_service_centres(area_or_landmark?: string, emirate?: string, centre_name?: string, capability?: string, vehicle_model?: string, open_now?: boolean, limit?: number) -> {total: number, area_resolved: string, emirate_needed: boolean, nearest_centre_id: string, nearest_centre_name: string, centres: {centre_id: string, name: string, emirate: string, area: string, phone: string, open_now: boolean, capabilities: string[], express_service: boolean, key_drop: boolean, shuttle: string, open_sunday: boolean, pickup_dropoff: boolean, free_collection_offer: string}[]}
    description: "Find Toyota service centres, nearest first, for a place, landmark, emirate or centre name. Place names can be given in English or Arabic. Filters to centres that can do the job or take the car: capability is one of regular, express, hybrid, electric, gr, commercial, coaster, supra, body_shop, smart_repair, speed_limit_certificate, emergency_walkin. With open_now true only centres that are open at this moment are returned. emirate_needed is true when the place is unclear and the emirate must be asked. nearest_centre_id and nearest_centre_name repeat the first centre returned. shuttle and free_collection_offer are given in words, per current policy, and are empty when there is none. Never offer a centre that this tool did not return for the requested capability."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      area_or_landmark:
        description: "Place the caller named, in English or Arabic, for example Global Village, Al Quoz or near Mall of the Emirates"
      emirate:
        description: "Emirate name in English, for example Dubai or Sharjah, asked only when the place is unclear"
      centre_name:
        description: "Centre the caller named, for example Al Badia, SZR or Wave, when they ask for a centre and not a place"
      capability:
        description: "Work the centre must be able to do, from the list in the description"
      vehicle_model:
        description: "Model of the car, used to exclude centres that cannot service it, for example Supra or 86"
      open_now:
        description: "True to return only centres that are open at this moment, for example for an emergency walk-in"
      limit:
        description: "Most centres to return, nearest first. Leave empty for all"
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, area_resolved, emirate_needed, nearest_centre_id, nearest_centre_name, centres[].centre_id, centres[].name, centres[].emirate, centres[].area, centres[].phone, centres[].open_now, centres[].express_service, centres[].key_drop, centres[].shuttle, centres[].open_sunday, centres[].pickup_dropoff, centres[].free_collection_offer]

# call over in the same step (section L of the flow).
HANDOFF:
  - TO: Toyota_Safety_Roadside_Agent
    WHEN: safety_flag == true
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model, safety_note]
      summary: "The caller reported a possible safety problem while confirming, changing or cancelling a service booking: {{safety_note}}"
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: false

  - TO: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
    WHEN: needs_person == true
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, booking_reference, handover_reason, handover_summary, handover_queue]
      summary: "{{handover_summary}}"
      history: full
    EXPECT_RETURN: false

CONSTRAINTS:
  always:
    # A04, Q06: nothing is changed, cancelled or replaced before the caller's clear yes.
    # caller_confirmed is set only by the fixed step on the confirmed branch and cleared after each write.
    - REQUIRE caller_confirmed == true BEFORE calling update_service_booking
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK

    - REQUIRE caller_confirmed == true BEFORE calling cancel_service_booking
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK

    - REQUIRE caller_confirmed == true BEFORE calling create_service_booking
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK

    # Only a slot that the live search returned can be held (same rule as E85)
    - REQUIRE picked_slot IS SET BEFORE calling hold_service_slot
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK

    # The last digits of the number are confirmed before a message is sent (same rule as Q08)
    - REQUIRE sms_number_confirmed == true BEFORE calling send_customer_message
      ON_FAIL: BLOCK

ON_ERROR:
  # E26: the tool library retries a slow system once (the tools that change something and have
  # no idempotency key do not retry at all, so no retry is added here); a call that still fails
  # goes to the step's ON_FAILURE branch, which hands the call to a person.
  tool_error:
    RETRY: 0
    THEN: CONTINUE

  # E26: one retry, then a person. Such a hand-over carries no reason: the handover agent
  # treats it as system trouble.
  llm_error:
    RETRY: 1
    THEN: HANDOFF
    HANDOFF_TARGET: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent

  timeout_error:
    RETRY: 1
    THEN: HANDOFF
    HANDOFF_TARGET: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent

  unknown_error:
    RETRY: 0
    THEN: HANDOFF
    HANDOFF_TARGET: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent

# How the reasoning steps are bounded:
# - Each one exits as soon as step_outcome is set, and is entered only from a step that clears
#   step_outcome first, so a stale answer can never be taken for a new one.
# - MAX_ATTEMPTS counts every turn a step ends without an outcome, the turn in which it asks
#   its question included. 4 therefore allows the question and two requests to rephrase (the
#   same rule as E20); the next answer that still cannot be used ends the step. The four steps
#   that read a value back before they store it have one turn more (5). ON_EXHAUSTED says
#   where the call goes.
# - Business counts (plate read-backs, slot options, centre tries, lost-slot searches) are
#   counters in fixed steps and are never left to the model.
# - AVAILABLE_TOOLS names one read-only tool that takes no parameters (today's date), so that no
#   booking tool is ever offered to the model: every booking tool is called by a fixed step, and
#   writes need caller_confirmed.
# - A tool result is read in the turn of the call only. Whatever a later turn needs is copied
#   into a declared variable in that same turn.
# - After a failed call the ON_RESULT branches that carry a condition are still evaluated, so

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # A. Entry. No greeting: the supervisor owns the opening.
  # Working state is reset here so a second request in the same call starts clean; a caller
  # who comes back mid-task resumes at the step they left, with its state.
  # The confirmation goes to the number already confirmed on this call, or else to the number
  # the caller is calling from; either way its last three digits are confirmed before sending.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      contact_mobile = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(contact_mobile, caller_phone)
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, switch_action, switch_count, requested_action, caller_note, concern_note, safety_flag, safety_note, needs_person, handover_reason, handover_summary, handover_detail, owner_only, message_language, today_date, today_weekday]
    THEN: reset_lookup

  reset_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [lookup_mode, lookup_customer_id, lookup_reference, lookup_plate, lookup_mobile, profile_empty, another_booking, booking_options, selected_booking, booking_open, plate_try_count, which_car_count, restart_count, current_centre_id, current_centre_name, current_start_time, current_start_label, current_service_label, current_service_code, current_status, booking_date, booking_can_change, booking_owner_id, booking_has_pickup]
    THEN: reset_slot

  reset_slot:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [requested_date, preferred_time, window_start, window_end, date_ok, closed_holiday, day_closed_name, day_closed_date, no_slot_date, day_needed, slot_options, slot_options_date, slot_lost, chosen_slot_id, picked_slot, held_hold_id, slot_round_count, slot_retry_count, options_ran_out, change_reason_code, change_reason_text, change_notes, late_mode]
    THEN: reset_change

  reset_change:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [target_centre_id, target_centre_name, centre_move, centre_place, centre_emirate, centre_none, centre_search_count, centre_options, chosen_centre_id, picked_centre, replaced_booking_reference, replacement_contact_name, replacement_contact_mobile, replacement_customer_id, new_booking_reference, refusal_reason, jobs_to_add, job_count, cancel_reason_code, cancel_reason_text, late_fee_aed, cancel_was_recall, caller_confirmed, change_made, new_contact_mobile, contact_last_digits, sms_number_confirmed, message_template, cancel_message, team_mobile, team_customer_name, team_summary]
    THEN: owner_gate

  # OPEN E95 (contact centre): Can someone who booked for the owner also change or cancel that
  # booking, or only the owner? Until agreed, a booking in someone else's name goes to a person:
  # a caller who is calling for the owner before any booking is looked up or read out, and any
  # caller as soon as they say the booking is someone else's (every reasoning step listens for
  # it while owner_only is true). Set the flag to "true" to let them carry on.
  owner_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_THIRD_PARTY_ALLOWED}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: owner_only_set
    THEN: entry_reference_check

  owner_only_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      owner_only = true
    THEN: owner_identity_gate

  owner_identity_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: identity_status != "third_party" AND identity_status != "third_party_verified"
    ON_FAIL: escape_other_name
    THEN: entry_reference_check

  # A reference is already known when the outbound agent hands a reminder call over.
  entry_reference_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_reference IS SET AND booking_reference != ""
    ON_FAIL: entry_profile_check
    THEN: lookup_known_reference

  lookup_known_reference:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_mode = "known_reference"
      lookup_reference = booking_reference
    CLEAR: [lookup_customer_id, lookup_plate, lookup_mobile]
    THEN: find_booking

  # E90, E94: a known caller's booking is looked up on the profile. E92: a caller with no
  # profile starts with the booking reference. That is a guest, and also a caller who arrives
  # with identity_status "unknown": the calling number is not on file and nobody has been asked
  # anything, so nothing personal is looked up or said before the booking is found.
  # OPEN E95 with the flag set to "true": someone calling for the owner who has not passed the
  # one-time code (identity_status "third_party") is not given the owner's bookings from the
  # profile either. They find the booking the same way, by its reference or by plate and
  # phone, so nothing is read out before one of those keys has matched.
  entry_profile_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: crm_customer_id IS SET AND crm_customer_id != "" AND identity_status != "guest" AND identity_status != "unknown" AND identity_status != "third_party"
    ON_FAIL: reference_prep
    THEN: entry_plate_check

  # The car is already known when the identity agent asked which car: no second question (E91).
  entry_plate_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: plate_number IS SET AND plate_number != ""
    ON_FAIL: lookup_profile_all
    THEN: lookup_profile_car

  lookup_profile_car:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_mode = "profile_car"
      lookup_customer_id = crm_customer_id
      lookup_plate = plate_number
    CLEAR: [lookup_reference, lookup_mobile]
    THEN: find_booking

  lookup_profile_all:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_mode = "profile_all"
      lookup_customer_id = crm_customer_id
    CLEAR: [lookup_reference, lookup_plate, lookup_mobile]
    THEN: find_booking

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # B. Find the booking.
  # E93: one lookup with no channel filter returns bookings made by phone, WhatsApp, the
  # website and at the branch. E94: the same lookup answers "did I already book?".
  # The booking system matches every filter it is given, so the filters a lookup does not use
  # are cleared before the call, and it refuses a call with no filter at all (ON_FAILURE).
  # It returns bookings from the start of today: one that is still to come, one whose car is
  # at the centre today, and one that was missed today (P13).
  # A reference the caller picked from several bookings must give exactly one booking; if it
  # does not, that counts as a failed pick, so the which-car question stays bounded.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  find_booking:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_service_bookings
      WITH:
        customer_id: lookup_customer_id
        plate_number: lookup_plate
        mobile_number: lookup_mobile
        booking_reference: lookup_reference
      AS: found
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: found.total == 1
        SET:
          selected_booking = found.bookings[0]
        THEN: select_booking
      - IF: found.total > 1 AND lookup_mode == "picked"
        THEN: which_car_retry
      - IF: found.total > 1
        THEN: which_car_first
      - ELSE:
        THEN: not_found_known_ref
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_system

  # What the later turns need from the booking is copied out of the lookup result here. The
  # start time in words (start_label) comes from the booking system, so no step works a
  # weekday out. can_change is the booking system's answer for Q07.
  select_booking:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_reference = selected_booking.booking_reference
      plate_number = selected_booking.plate_number
      vehicle_model = selected_booking.vehicle_model
      current_centre_id = selected_booking.centre_id
      current_centre_name = selected_booking.centre_name
      current_start_time = selected_booking.start_time
      current_start_label = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_booking.start_label, selected_booking.start_time)
      current_service_label = selected_booking.service_label
      current_service_code = selected_booking.service_code
      current_status = selected_booking.status
      booking_date = SUBSTRING(selected_booking.start_time, 0, 10)
      booking_can_change = selected_booking.can_change
      booking_owner_id = selected_booking.belongs_to_customer_id
      booking_has_pickup = selected_booking.pickup_dropoff
      target_centre_id = selected_booking.centre_id
      target_centre_name = selected_booking.centre_name
      booking_open = true
    THEN: owner_known_check

  # OPEN E95 (contact centre): see owner_gate. The booking system says whose booking it is.
  # When the caller has a profile and the booking belongs to another profile, the booking is in
  # someone else's name: a person, before anything about the booking is said. A caller with no
  # profile who found the booking as E92 says (reference, or plate and phone) carries on.
  # A booking that was looked up on the caller's own profile is theirs and is not compared.
  owner_known_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: owner_only == true AND lookup_mode != "profile_car" AND lookup_mode != "profile_all" AND crm_customer_id IS SET AND crm_customer_id != "" AND booking_owner_id IS SET AND booking_owner_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: vehicle_check
    THEN: owner_match_check

  owner_match_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_owner_id == crm_customer_id
    ON_FAIL: escape_other_name
    THEN: vehicle_check

  # The vehicle id passed in belongs to the car the identity agent picked. It is kept only
  # when the booking was looked up for that same car.
  vehicle_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "profile_car"
    ON_FAIL: drop_vehicle_id
    THEN: present_prep

  drop_vehicle_id:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [vehicle_id]
    THEN: present_prep

  # Nothing found: fall through the lookup order, one stage at a time.
  not_found_known_ref:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "known_reference"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_profile_car
    THEN: drop_known_reference

  drop_known_reference:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [booking_reference, lookup_reference]
    THEN: entry_profile_check

  not_found_profile_car:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "profile_car"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_profile_all
    THEN: lookup_profile_all

  not_found_profile_all:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "profile_all"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_reference
    THEN: profile_empty_note

  profile_empty_note:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      profile_empty = true
    THEN: reference_prep

  not_found_reference:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "reference"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_picked
    THEN: reference_missed

  reference_missed:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I couldn't find a booking with that reference."
    MESSAGE_KEY: reference_not_found
    THEN: plate_known_check

  not_found_picked:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "picked"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_plate_phone
    THEN: which_car_retry

  not_found_plate_phone:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "plate_phone"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_plate_contact
    THEN: contact_known_check

  # E92: the contact number of this call was tried as well (lookup_by_plate_contact): only now
  # is the caller asked which mobile number the booking was made with.
  not_found_plate_contact:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "plate_contact"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_prep
    THEN: mobile_prep

  # E92: booking reference first, the DBM or service order number on the SMS.
  # P13 (missed): the lookup returns bookings from the start of today, so a booking missed
  # today is found. One that was missed on an earlier day is not: a caller with nothing on the
  # profile who says so needs a new booking, and that is handed back.
  reference_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, lookup_reference]
    THEN: ask_reference

  ask_reference:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller wants to confirm, change or cancel a service booking, and it has not been found yet.
      {{#if profile_empty}}No service booking from today onwards shows for this caller. Say so in a few words first. If they say they missed a booking on an earlier day, a new booking is needed: hand that back with __return_to_parent__.{{/if}}
      {{#if another_booking}}The booking that was found is not the one they mean. Ask for the reference of the booking they do mean.{{/if}}
      Ask for the booking reference on their confirmation message: the DBM or service order
      number. If they have already said it in this call, do not ask again; a reference that
      was already looked up and not found does not count.
      Read it back one character at a time and wait for a yes. Then store it in
      lookup_reference and set step_outcome to "answered".
      If they do not have it, set step_outcome to "no_reference". Ask for nothing else in this step.
      If they no longer want to go on with this, set step_outcome to "stop".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Anything that is not about an existing service booking: hand it back with
      __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 5
    ON_EXHAUSTED: plate_known_check
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: reference_route

  reference_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered" AND lookup_reference IS SET AND lookup_reference != ""
    ON_FAIL: reference_none
    THEN: lookup_by_reference

  # E92: no reference, or an answer that carried no reference: the next key in the order.
  reference_none:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "no_reference" OR step_outcome == "answered"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: plate_known_check

  lookup_by_reference:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_mode = "reference"
    CLEAR: [lookup_customer_id, lookup_plate, lookup_mobile]
    THEN: find_booking

  # E92: then plate and phone. A plate that is already known is not asked for again.
  plate_known_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: plate_number IS SET AND plate_number != ""
    ON_FAIL: plate_prep
    THEN: use_known_plate

  use_known_plate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_plate = plate_number
    THEN: phone_known_check

  plate_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, lookup_plate]
    THEN: ask_plate

  ask_plate:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The booking is being looked up by the car. Ask for the plate number of the car: the
      emirate, the code and the number. If they have already said it in this call, and that
      plate has not been read back and rejected, do not ask again.
      Store what you heard in lookup_plate and set step_outcome to "answered". Do not read it
      back in this step.
      If they no longer want to go on with this, set step_outcome to "stop".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Anything that is not about an existing service booking: hand it back with
      __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_plate
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: plate_route

  plate_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered" AND lookup_plate IS SET AND lookup_plate != ""
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: plate_count

  # Same rule as E55: the plate is read back in short chunks; after two rejected read-backs
  # the call goes to a person. plate_try_count counts the read-backs.
  plate_count:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      plate_try_count = ADD(plate_try_count, 1)
    CLEAR: [step_outcome]
    THEN: confirm_plate

  confirm_plate:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Read this plate number back to the caller in short chunks (the emirate, the code, then
      the digits two or three at a time) and ask if it is right: {{lookup_plate}}
      Only an answer the caller gives after you have read it back counts.
      - Yes: set step_outcome to "yes".
      - No: set step_outcome to "no". Do not ask for the plate in this step.
      - They no longer want to go on with this: set step_outcome to "stop".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Anything that is not about an existing service booking: hand it back with
      __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_plate
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: plate_confirm_route

  plate_confirm_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "yes"
    ON_FAIL: plate_rejected
    THEN: phone_known_check

  plate_rejected:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "no"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: plate_try_limit

  plate_try_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: plate_try_count < 2
    ON_FAIL: escape_plate
    THEN: plate_prep

  # The number the caller is calling from is tried first, so it is not asked for.
  phone_known_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: caller_phone IS SET AND caller_phone != ""
    ON_FAIL: contact_known_check
    THEN: lookup_by_plate_phone

  lookup_by_plate_phone:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_mode = "plate_phone"
      lookup_mobile = caller_phone
    CLEAR: [lookup_customer_id, lookup_reference]
    THEN: find_booking

  # E92: a number the caller gave or confirmed earlier in this call (contact_mobile, passed in
  # by the supervisor) is tried next when it is a different number, so the caller is not asked
  # again for a number they have already said. When nothing was passed in, contact_mobile is
  # the calling number (step start) and this lookup is skipped.
  contact_known_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: contact_mobile IS SET AND contact_mobile != "" AND contact_mobile != caller_phone
    ON_FAIL: mobile_prep
    THEN: lookup_by_plate_contact

  lookup_by_plate_contact:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_mode = "plate_contact"
      lookup_mobile = contact_mobile
    CLEAR: [lookup_customer_id, lookup_reference]
    THEN: find_booking

  mobile_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, lookup_mobile]
    THEN: ask_booking_mobile

  ask_booking_mobile:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The booking is being looked up by the car and the phone number on the booking. The number
      the caller is calling from, when there is one, and any other number they gave earlier in
      this call have already been tried and gave no booking: do not offer them. Ask which
      mobile number the booking was made with.
      Read the number back in groups of three or four digits and wait for a yes. Then store it
      in lookup_mobile in international format, for example +971501234567, and set
      step_outcome to "answered".
      If they do not know it, set step_outcome to "unknown".
      If they no longer want to go on with this, set step_outcome to "stop".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Anything that is not about an existing service booking: hand it back with
      __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 5
    ON_EXHAUSTED: not_found_prep
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: mobile_route

  mobile_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered" AND lookup_mobile IS SET AND lookup_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: mobile_unknown
    THEN: lookup_by_plate_mobile

  # E92: the caller does not know the number, or the answer carried none: nothing more to try.
  mobile_unknown:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "unknown" OR step_outcome == "answered"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: not_found_prep

  lookup_by_plate_mobile:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_mode = "plate_mobile"
    CLEAR: [lookup_customer_id, lookup_reference]
    THEN: find_booking

  # E91: several future bookings. Ask which car, never list them. The caller's answer is
  # matched to one booking and that booking is read again from the booking system.
  # The list can also hold a booking whose car is at the centre today or one missed today; its
  # status is given to the model for matching only.
  which_car_first:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_options = found.bookings
    THEN: which_car_prep

  # The caller's answer did not match a booking: one more try, then a person.
  which_car_retry:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      which_car_count = ADD(which_car_count, 1)
    THEN: which_car_limit

  which_car_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: which_car_count < 2
    ON_FAIL: escape_not_identified
    THEN: which_car_prep

  which_car_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, lookup_reference]
    THEN: ask_which_car

  ask_which_car:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller has more than one service booking. Ask which car they are calling
      about. Do not list the cars, the bookings or any of their details. If they have already
      said which car in this call, do not ask again.
      The bookings, for matching only, never to be read out:
      {{#each booking_options}}
      - reference {{this.booking_reference}}: {{this.vehicle_model}}, plate {{this.plate_number}}, {{this.start_label}}, {{this.centre_name}}, status {{this.status}}
      {{/each}}
      When what they say (the model, the plate, the day or the centre) matches exactly one
      booking, store that booking's reference in lookup_reference and set step_outcome to
      "answered". If it matches none or more than one, ask again in a few words.
      If they no longer want to go on with this, set step_outcome to "stop".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Anything that is not about an existing service booking: hand it back with
      __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_identified
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: which_car_route

  which_car_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered" AND lookup_reference IS SET AND lookup_reference != ""
    ON_FAIL: which_car_unmatched
    THEN: lookup_picked

  # E91: an answer that named no booking counts as a failed pick: one more try, then a person.
  which_car_unmatched:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: which_car_retry

  lookup_picked:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      lookup_mode = "picked"
    CLEAR: [lookup_customer_id, lookup_plate, lookup_mobile]
    THEN: find_booking

  # Nothing found by reference, plate and phone.
  not_found_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome]
    THEN: not_found_close

  not_found_close:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      No service booking from today onwards was found with the details the caller gave. Tell
      them so plainly in one sentence. Do not guess and do not read out anything else.
      In the same turn ask one short question, so that the caller is not left waiting after a
      statement: whether they have another detail of the booking you could look with.
      Then listen. Only what the caller says after you have told them counts:
      - They are sure a booking exists, or want it checked further: put a short summary in
        caller_note and set step_outcome to "person".
      - They missed a booking on an earlier day, or would like to book a service now: hand
        that request back with __return_to_parent__.
      - They give other details, or come back to ask about a booking again: set step_outcome
        to "look_again".
      - They are fine with that: set step_outcome to "done".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Anything that is not about an existing service booking: hand it back with
      __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_found
    THEN: not_found_done

  not_found_done:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "done"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_person
    THEN: acknowledge

  not_found_person:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "person"
    ON_FAIL: not_found_again
    THEN: escape_not_found

  # New details, or a caller who comes back after booking: the lookup starts again, within
  # the same limit as "I mean a different booking".
  not_found_again:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "look_again"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: look_again_reset

  # The car and the details the earlier lookups used are dropped, so the new details the
  # caller gives are taken and a plate that was passed in is not tried a second time.
  look_again_reset:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      restart_count = ADD(restart_count, 1)
    CLEAR: [plate_number, vehicle_model, vehicle_id, lookup_reference, lookup_plate, lookup_mobile, profile_empty, another_booking]
    THEN: restart_limit

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # C. The booking is found: mention it and find out what the caller wants.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  present_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, requested_action]
    THEN: present_booking

  # E90: mentions the future booking and asks whether to change it. E94: the same offer for a
  # caller who forgot they had booked. E99: the self-service link in the confirmation message.
  # P13: a booking that was missed today is found too; the caller is told its time has passed
  # and is offered the next free time. A booking whose car is at the centre today is not one
  # to move: questions about the car itself are handed back.
  present_booking:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      You have found the caller's service booking: {{vehicle_model}}, plate
      {{plate_number}}, at {{current_centre_name}}, {{current_start_label}}. What it is
      booked for: {{current_service_label}} (blank means not recorded: then do not name it).
      Its status is "{{current_status}}": confirmed means it is still to come, missed means
      its time has passed and the car did not come, in_workshop means the car is at the
      centre now.
      If the caller has already said exactly what they want done with it (for example cancel
      it, move it to another day, add a job), say nothing and store it.
      Otherwise tell them in one sentence that you can see the booking (the car by its model,
      the day and date, the time and the centre) and ask whether they would like to keep it
      as it is or change it. If they only say they want to change it, ask what they would
      like to change.
      For a missed booking say instead that its time has passed, and ask whether they would
      like the next free time.
      For a booking with the status in_workshop say that the car is at the centre for it, and
      ask in the same turn what they would like to do. A question about the car's progress,
      the bill or collecting the car is not for you: hand it back with __return_to_parent__.
      Store what they want in requested_action and set step_outcome to "answered":
      confirm (they only want to check it is booked), resend (they want the confirmation
      message again), reschedule (another day or time), late (they are running late or missed
      it), change_centre, add_job, cancel, keep (leave it as it is), other_booking (they mean a
      different car or booking), other_change (any other change to the booking, such as the
      service itself, the advisor, or pick-up and drop-off: describe it in caller_note).
      If they ask whether they can change or cancel it themselves: yes, with the link in the
      confirmation message. Offer to send that message again or to do it for them now.
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Anything that is not about an existing service booking: hand it back with
      __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: present_route

  present_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered" AND requested_action IS SET
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: action_change

  action_change:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "reschedule" OR requested_action == "late" OR requested_action == "change_centre" OR requested_action == "add_job" OR requested_action == "cancel"
    ON_FAIL: action_confirm
    THEN: change_allowed_gate

  # OPEN Q07 (contact centre): How close to the booked time can a customer still change or
  # cancel it? Until agreed this agent applies no cut-off of its own: a booking is changed or
  # cancelled on the day itself. The booking system is the only judge: when it says the booking
  # can no longer be changed (can_change false here, or the refusal too_late when the change
  # is saved), the call goes to a person (A04). A booking whose answer is missing is treated
  # as changeable, because the booking system still refuses a change it does not allow.
  change_allowed_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_can_change == false
    ON_FAIL: today_known_check
    THEN: escape_too_late

  # E96, P13: today's date is read once per task; a change of mind does not read it again.
  today_known_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: today_date IS SET AND today_date != ""
    ON_FAIL: today_load
    THEN: same_day_gate

  # E96, P13, Q07: today's date and weekday in the UAE come from the booking system's calendar,
  # never from the model and never from the server clock. They are read once a change is asked
  # for: the day gate below and every step that turns "tomorrow" or "Thursday" into a date use
  # them.
  today_load:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_local_date_time
      AS: clock
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: clock.date IS SET AND clock.date != ""
        SET:
          today_date = clock.date
          today_weekday = clock.weekday
        THEN: same_day_gate
      - ELSE:
        THEN: today_unknown
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: today_unknown

  # The calendar did not answer. A cancellation or an added job needs no date and carries on;
  # a new day or time cannot be worked out safely, so those go to a person (time_today_gate).
  today_unknown:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [today_date, today_weekday]
    THEN: same_day_gate

  # OPEN Q07 (contact centre): the day-level switch. Set the flag to "false" to send every
  # change on the day of the booking to a person. With the flag off, a booking whose day cannot
  # be compared with today (the calendar did not answer) also goes to a person.
  same_day_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_SAME_DAY_ALLOWED}}" != "false")
    ON_FAIL: same_day_check
    THEN: action_reschedule

  same_day_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: today_date IS SET AND today_date != "" AND booking_date != today_date
    ON_FAIL: escape_same_day
    THEN: action_reschedule

  action_reschedule:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "reschedule"
    ON_FAIL: action_cancel
    THEN: time_start

  action_cancel:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "cancel"
    ON_FAIL: action_late
    THEN: cancel_prep

  action_late:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "late"
    ON_FAIL: action_job
    THEN: late_start

  action_job:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "add_job"
    ON_FAIL: centre_start
    THEN: job_prep

  action_confirm:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "confirm"
    ON_FAIL: action_keep
    THEN: confirm_flag_gate

  action_keep:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "keep"
    ON_FAIL: action_resend
    THEN: keep_booking

  action_resend:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "resend"
    ON_FAIL: action_other
    THEN: sms_prep

  action_other:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "other_booking"
    ON_FAIL: action_unsupported
    THEN: restart_lookup

  # A04: a change the agent cannot make in the booking system goes to a person.
  action_unsupported:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action == "other_change"
    ON_FAIL: escape_not_understood
    THEN: escape_other_change

  # The caller means a different booking: widen the lookup once, then ask for the reference.
  restart_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      restart_count = ADD(restart_count, 1)
      another_booking = true
    CLEAR: [booking_reference, selected_booking, booking_open, plate_number, vehicle_model, vehicle_id, requested_action, lookup_reference, lookup_plate, lookup_mobile, profile_empty, current_centre_id, current_centre_name, current_start_time, current_start_label, current_service_label, current_service_code, current_status, booking_date, booking_can_change, booking_owner_id, booking_has_pickup]
    THEN: restart_limit

  restart_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: restart_count <= 2
    ON_FAIL: escape_not_identified
    THEN: restart_route

  restart_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "profile_car"
    ON_FAIL: restart_picked
    THEN: lookup_profile_all

  # E91: a caller with several bookings who means another one of them is asked which car
  # again, not for a reference. The list is the one the booking system returned.
  restart_picked:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: lookup_mode == "picked" AND booking_options IS SET
    ON_FAIL: reference_prep
    THEN: which_car_prep

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # D. Confirm the booking.
  # OPEN E126 (contact centre): Is this still right? Until answered the booking is read back
  # (date, time and centre) and the confirmation is sent again if the caller asks. The
  # read-back ends with that offer, so the caller is never left waiting after a statement.
  # Set the flag to "false" to pass confirmation calls to a person instead.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  confirm_flag_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_CONFIRM_READBACK}}" != "false")
    ON_FAIL: escape_confirm_disabled
    THEN: confirm_prep

  confirm_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome]
    THEN: confirm_booking

  confirm_booking:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller wants to confirm their service booking. Read it back in one sentence: the
      day and date, the time and the centre. The booking: {{vehicle_model}},
      {{current_start_label}}, at {{current_centre_name}}.
      In the same turn ask one short question, so that the caller is not left waiting after a
      statement: whether they would like the confirmation message sent again.
      Then listen. Only what the caller says after you have read it back counts:
      - They would like the confirmation message again: set step_outcome to "resend".
      - They do not need it, or are simply happy: set step_outcome to "done".
      If they ask whether they can change or cancel it themselves: yes, with the link in the
      confirmation message.
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: acknowledge
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: confirm_route

  confirm_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "resend"
    ON_FAIL: confirm_done
    THEN: sms_prep

  confirm_done:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "done"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: acknowledge

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # E. Change the date or time (E96), also for a caller who is late or missed it (P13).
  # Slot rules are the same as for a new booking: holiday list first (N02), live slots only
  # (E78), one option at a time and three at most (Q05), then the booking is kept (E98).
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Each new search for a time starts its own count of options, and its own reason: a reason
  # the caller gave earlier in the call is still in the conversation and is stored again
  # without a second question.
  time_start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      target_centre_id = current_centre_id
      target_centre_name = current_centre_name
      centre_move = false
      late_mode = false
      slot_round_count = 0
    CLEAR: [change_reason_code, change_reason_text]
    THEN: time_today_gate

  # E96: a day the caller names can only be turned into a date when today's date is known.
  time_today_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: today_date IS SET AND today_date != ""
    ON_FAIL: escape_system
    THEN: time_prep

  # OPEN P13 (contact centre): Does the contact centre currently tell the service centre when
  # a customer is running late? Until answered: offer the next free slot (the slot search never
  # returns a slot less than the lead time the booking system applies), then another day, and
  # tell the centre nothing. See keep_late_gate for the flag.
  # The reason for the move is known here, so it is recorded without asking (Q06).
  late_start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      target_centre_id = current_centre_id
      target_centre_name = current_centre_name
      centre_move = false
      late_mode = true
      slot_round_count = 0
      requested_date = booking_date
      change_reason_code = "other"
      change_reason_text = "The customer is running late or missed the booking"
    CLEAR: [preferred_time, window_start, window_end]
    THEN: late_today_gate

  late_today_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: today_date IS SET AND today_date != ""
    ON_FAIL: escape_system
    THEN: round_count

  time_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, requested_date, preferred_time, window_start, window_end]
    THEN: ask_new_time

  ask_new_time:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller is moving their service booking for the {{vehicle_model}}. It is now
      {{current_start_label}} ({{current_start_time}}) at {{current_centre_name}}; the new
      time will be at {{target_centre_name}}. Today is {{today_weekday}}, {{today_date}}.
      {{#if day_closed_name}}The day they asked for, {{day_closed_date}}, is a public holiday ({{day_closed_name}}) and the service centres are closed. Say so first.{{/if}}
      {{#if no_slot_date}}Nothing is free on {{no_slot_date}}. Say so first.{{/if}}
      {{#if centre_move}}They are moving to {{target_centre_name}}: offer to keep the same day and time as now, unless they have asked for another.{{/if}}
      {{#if day_needed}}Their last answer named no day. Ask which day they would like.{{/if}}
      If none of the lines above gives you something to say first, and the caller has already
      said a day in this call that has not been tried yet, ask nothing and say nothing: store
      it as described below. The next step speaks, and anything you say now would be heard
      after it.
      Otherwise ask which day and roughly what time would suit. If the caller has not yet
      heard which booking this is, start with it in a few words: the car, the day and time,
      and the centre. If they name a weekday that is also today's weekday, ask whether they
      mean today or next week.
      Work the day out from today's date above and store it in requested_date as YYYY-MM-DD.
      If they give a period and no day (any day next week, as soon as possible), store the
      first day of that period. For an exact time store preferred_time as 24-hour HH:MM. For a
      part of the day such as "after work" or "tomorrow morning" store window_start and
      window_end as 24-hour HH:MM. Then set step_outcome to "answered".
      If they decide to leave the booking as it is, set step_outcome to "keep".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
