    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: time_asked

  time_asked:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [day_closed_name, day_closed_date, no_slot_date, day_needed]
    THEN: time_route

  time_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: time_day_given

  # E96: an answer with no day in it (a time only) is asked for once more instead of ending
  # the task (same rule as E20). It counts as one of the three options, so this cannot loop.
  time_day_given:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_date IS SET AND requested_date != ""
    ON_FAIL: time_day_missing
    THEN: round_count

  time_day_missing:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      slot_round_count = ADD(slot_round_count, 1)
      day_needed = true
    THEN: time_again_check

  # Same rule as Q05: up to three options. Every day that is checked counts as one.
  # The results of the checks on the day before are dropped before the next day is checked.
  round_count:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      slot_round_count = ADD(slot_round_count, 1)
    CLEAR: [date_ok, closed_holiday]
    THEN: round_limit

  # Before the caller is asked for another day the count is checked, so nobody is asked for a
  # day that would not be searched: after the third option the booking is kept (E98).
  time_again_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_round_count < 3
    ON_FAIL: nothing_suits
    THEN: time_prep

  # E98: nothing new suits, so the current booking is kept.
  round_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_round_count <= 3
    ON_FAIL: nothing_suits
    THEN: date_parse

  # E98: when the options run out the caller hears why and that the booking stays as it is,
  # in one line (keep_said_none).
  nothing_suits:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      options_ran_out = true
    THEN: keep_booking

  # The day must be a real YYYY-MM-DD date before it goes to the booking system. A day that
  # is not is asked for again, and still counts as one of the three options.
  date_parse:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      date_ok = REGEX_EXTRACT(requested_date, "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$")
    THEN: date_valid

  date_valid:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: date_ok IS SET AND date_ok != ""
    ON_FAIL: time_again_check
    THEN: check_holidays

  # Same rule as N02: the holiday list is checked before any slot is offered.
  check_holidays:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_public_holidays
      WITH:
        from_date: requested_date
        to_date: requested_date
      AS: holiday_check
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_system
    THEN: holiday_eval

  holiday_eval:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      closed_holiday = ARRAY_FIND(holiday_check.holidays, "centres_closed", true)
    THEN: holiday_gate

  holiday_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: closed_holiday IS NOT SET
    ON_FAIL: holiday_closed
    THEN: search_slots

  holiday_closed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      day_closed_name = closed_holiday.name
      day_closed_date = requested_date
    THEN: time_again_check

  # Same rule as E78: only live slots are offered. The whole day is read, so that the first
  # time inside the part of the day the caller asked for, or else the nearest time, can be offered.
  # The service code of the booking is passed so that the slot is long enough for the job; it
  # is empty for a visit that is not a service.
  search_slots:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_service_slots
      WITH:
        centre_id: target_centre_id
        date: requested_date
        service_code: current_service_code
      AS: slot_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: slot_search.total > 0
        THEN: offer_prep
      - ELSE:
        THEN: no_slots_day
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_system

  # Nothing that day: the next day with a free slot, when the booking system names one.
  no_slots_day:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      no_slot_date = requested_date
    THEN: next_day_check

  next_day_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_search.next_available_date IS SET AND slot_search.next_available_date != "" AND slot_search.next_available_date != requested_date
    ON_FAIL: time_again_check
    THEN: next_day_set

  next_day_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      requested_date = slot_search.next_available_date
    THEN: round_count

  # A tool result lives for one turn. The free times are copied out of it here, in the turn of
  # the search, so the offer and the check of the caller's pick still have them a turn later.
  offer_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      slot_options = slot_search.slots
      slot_options_date = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(slot_search.date, requested_date)
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, chosen_slot_id, picked_slot]
    THEN: offer_slot

  offer_slot:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller is choosing a new time for their service booking at {{target_centre_name}}.
      Free times on {{slot_options_date}}, live from the booking system, each in words and as
      a timestamp:
      {{#each slot_options}}
      - {{this.start_label}} ({{this.start_time}}), slot id {{this.slot_id}}
      {{/each}}
      What they asked for: day {{requested_date}}, exact time {{preferred_time}}, part of the
      day {{window_start}} to {{window_end}} (blank means not given). Today is
      {{today_weekday}}, {{today_date}}.
      Their booking is now {{current_start_label}} ({{current_start_time}}) at {{current_centre_name}}.
      {{#if late_mode}}They are running late or missed their booking: offer the first time in the list that is later than the time their booking has now. That is the next free one: the list never holds a time closer than the lead time the booking system applies. If no time in the list is later than their booking, say so and ask whether another day would suit.{{/if}}
      {{#if no_slot_date}}Nothing was free on {{no_slot_date}}. Say so first.{{/if}}
      {{#if slot_lost}}The time they picked has just been taken. Say so first.{{/if}}
      If you have nothing to say first and the exact time they asked for is in the list, do
      not ask again: store its slot id in chosen_slot_id, set step_outcome to "picked" and say
      nothing. The next step reads the change back.
      Otherwise offer exactly one time from the list: the first time inside the part of the
      day they asked for, or else the time nearest to what they asked for. Say the day, date
      and time in the words the list gives, for example "Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm". Never
      offer or accept a time that is not in the list, and do not read the list out. Only an
      answer the caller gives after you have offered a time counts.
      When you make that offer and the caller has not yet heard on this call which booking
      this is, start with it in a few words: the car, the day and time, and the centre.
      Whatever they answer, store it and stop:
      - They accept the time, or ask for another time that is in the list: that slot id in
        chosen_slot_id and step_outcome "picked".
      - They want a time that is not in the list, or another day: the day in requested_date as
        YYYY-MM-DD, and overwrite preferred_time, window_start and window_end (24-hour HH:MM,
        an empty text for the ones that no longer apply), and step_outcome "other_time".
      - Nothing suits and they name no other day: step_outcome "none".
      - They would rather leave the booking as it is: step_outcome "keep".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: offer_done

  offer_done:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [no_slot_date, slot_lost]
    THEN: offer_route

  offer_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "picked" AND chosen_slot_id IS SET AND chosen_slot_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: offer_unpicked
    THEN: pick_eval

  # "Picked" with no slot named: the same day is read again and a time is offered again,
  # which counts as one of the three options (same rule as Q05).
  offer_unpicked:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "picked"
    ON_FAIL: offer_other
    THEN: round_count

  offer_other:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "other_time"
    ON_FAIL: offer_none
    THEN: time_day_given

  # "Then another day": the caller is asked for another day, within the three options.
  offer_none:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "none"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: time_again_check

  # The slot the caller accepted must be one the live search returned. Its time is read from
  # the search result, never from what the model remembers.
  pick_eval:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      picked_slot = ARRAY_FIND(slot_options, "slot_id", chosen_slot_id)
    THEN: pick_check

  pick_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: picked_slot IS SET
    ON_FAIL: round_count
    THEN: hold_slot

  # Same rule as E85: the slot is held as soon as it is picked. The hold id is kept, because
  # the change is saved in a later turn and the booking system wants it together with the slot.
  # A slot that cannot be held (taken, or closed by the centre) is treated as lost.
  hold_slot:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: hold_service_slot
      WITH:
        slot_id: picked_slot.slot_id
        plate_number: plate_number
      AS: hold_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: hold_result.held == true
        SET:
          held_hold_id = hold_result.hold_id
        THEN: reason_check
      - ELSE:
        THEN: slot_gone
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_system

  # Same rule as E85: a lost slot is searched once more. A04: after that, a person.
  # The day that is searched again is the day of the list the lost slot came from, which a
  # fixed step stored, so nothing the model wrote in between can change it.
  slot_gone:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      slot_retry_count = ADD(slot_retry_count, 1)
      slot_lost = true
      caller_confirmed = false
      requested_date = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(slot_options_date, requested_date)
    CLEAR: [held_hold_id, refusal_reason]
    THEN: slot_retry_limit

  slot_retry_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_retry_count <= 1
    ON_FAIL: escape_change_failed
    THEN: search_slots

  # OPEN Q06 (contact centre): What are the top reasons people cancel or reschedule?
  # Q06 is also E100. Until the list exists the reason for a reschedule is asked once and
  # recorded on the booking in the caller's words, with the closest reason code the booking
  # system has (the same codes as for a cancellation).
  reason_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: change_reason_text IS SET AND change_reason_text != ""
    ON_FAIL: reason_prep
    THEN: readback_prep

  reason_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome]
    THEN: ask_change_reason

  ask_change_reason:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller is moving their service booking and the new time is free and held for them:
      {{picked_slot.start_label}} at {{target_centre_name}}.
      If they have already given a reason for the change in this call, ask nothing and say
      nothing: store it as described below. The next step reads the change back, and anything
      you say now would be heard after it.
      Otherwise tell them in a few words that this time is free, then ask once what the reason
      for the change is, so that it can be noted.
      Whatever they answer, store the reason in their own words in change_reason_text, and the
      closest code in change_reason_code: schedule_conflict, car_not_available,
      serviced_elsewhere, price, booked_twice or other. If they would rather not say, use
      other and "not given". Then set step_outcome to "answered". Never ask a second time.
      If they would now rather leave the booking as it is, set step_outcome to "keep".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: reason_default
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: reason_route

  reason_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered" AND change_reason_text IS SET AND change_reason_text != ""
    ON_FAIL: reason_interrupt
    THEN: readback_prep

  reason_interrupt:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "safety" OR step_outcome == "person" OR step_outcome == "manager" OR step_outcome == "upset" OR step_outcome == "other_name" OR step_outcome == "switch" OR step_outcome == "keep" OR step_outcome == "stop"
    ON_FAIL: reason_default
    THEN: route_interrupt

  reason_default:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      change_reason_code = "other"
      change_reason_text = "not given"
    THEN: readback_prep

  # The change is read back in the E78 format and nothing is written before a clear yes.
  readback_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, refusal_reason]
    THEN: readback_change

  readback_change:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Read the change back to the caller in one sentence and ask for a clear yes. Nothing is
      changed before that yes.
      The change: their {{vehicle_model}} at {{target_centre_name}}, new time
      {{picked_slot.start_label}}, instead of {{current_start_label}} at
      {{current_centre_name}}. Name the car by its model; the plate is not read out again.
      Today is {{today_weekday}}, {{today_date}}.
      {{#if centre_move}}Say that this replaces the current booking with a new one at the new centre.{{/if}}
      {{#if booking_has_pickup}}The booking includes pick-up and drop-off. It stays on the booking, and the service centre arranges the driver after the call: say so in a few words.{{/if}}
      Say the day, date and time in the words given above, for example "Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm".
      Only an answer the caller gives after you have read the change back counts.
      - A clear yes: step_outcome "confirmed".
      - They want a different day or time: the day in requested_date as YYYY-MM-DD, and
        overwrite preferred_time, window_start and window_end (24-hour HH:MM, an empty text
        for the ones that no longer apply), and step_outcome "other_time".
      - They would rather leave the booking as it is: step_outcome "keep".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: readback_route

  readback_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "confirmed"
    ON_FAIL: readback_other
    THEN: commit_route

  # A change at the read-back goes back to the slot search and is read back again.
  readback_other:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "other_time"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: time_day_given

  commit_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: centre_move == true
    ON_FAIL: time_confirmed
    THEN: move_confirmed

  # E96: a change of date or time updates the same booking. A04: the change is made in the
  # booking system itself. Q06: the reason goes to the booking system as a code and the
  # caller's words; the notes carry only a concern about the car (same rule as E69).
  time_confirmed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = true
      change_reason_code = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(change_reason_code, "other")
      change_reason_text = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(change_reason_text, "not given")
    THEN: reason_code_check

  # Q06: a reason code that is not in the booking system's list is recorded as other. The
  # check runs right before the change is saved, so the code that is sent is always a listed one.
  reason_code_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: change_reason_code == "schedule_conflict" OR change_reason_code == "car_not_available" OR change_reason_code == "serviced_elsewhere" OR change_reason_code == "price" OR change_reason_code == "booked_twice" OR change_reason_code == "other"
    ON_FAIL: reason_code_other
    THEN: update_time

  reason_code_other:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      change_reason_code = "other"
    THEN: update_time

  # The booking system says why it refuses. too_late is its cut-off (Q07) and goes to a
  # person, as does a refusal the caller cannot mend. A lost slot, or a refusal with no
  # reason, is searched once more (same rule as E85).
  update_time:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: update_service_booking
      WITH:
        booking_reference: booking_reference
        new_slot_id: picked_slot.slot_id
        hold_id: held_hold_id
        notes: concern_note
        reason_code: change_reason_code
        reason_text: change_reason_text
      AS: update_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: update_result.updated == true
        THEN: time_changed
      - IF: update_result.failure_reason == "too_late"
        THEN: escape_too_late
      - IF: update_result.failure_reason == "job_not_allowed" OR update_result.failure_reason == "validation"
        SET:
          refusal_reason = update_result.failure_reason
        THEN: escape_change_failed
      - ELSE:
        THEN: update_refused
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_change_unknown

  update_refused:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
    THEN: slot_gone

  time_changed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      change_made = true
      late_mode = false
      current_start_time = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(update_result.start_time, picked_slot.start_time)
      current_start_label = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(update_result.start_label, picked_slot.start_label, update_result.start_time, picked_slot.start_time)
      booking_date = SUBSTRING(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(update_result.start_time, picked_slot.start_time), 0, 10)
    CLEAR: [concern_note, held_hold_id]
    RESPOND: "That's done, your booking is moved."
    MESSAGE_KEY: time_change_done
    THEN: sms_prep

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # F. Change the centre (E97): the booking is replaced with a new one.
  # The new slot is held, the change is read back, and after the caller's yes one call asks
  # the booking system to make the new booking in place of the old one. The booking system
  # does both in one transaction: the car never has two bookings and never has none. It keeps
  # the jobs, the advisor and the pick-up of the replaced booking, because this agent does not
  # send them again. The service code and the contact are sent again as the booking system
  # returned them, and the notes are sent again in full with what this call added.
  # Nothing is cancelled by this agent as part of a change of centre.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  centre_start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      replacement_contact_mobile = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_booking.contact_mobile, contact_mobile)
    THEN: centre_ready_check

  # The new booking needs the phone number of the person bringing the car: the one on the
  # booking, or else the number for this call. Without one nothing is started: a person.
  centre_ready_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: replacement_contact_mobile IS SET AND replacement_contact_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: escape_centre_not_ready
    THEN: centre_count

  centre_count:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      centre_search_count = ADD(centre_search_count, 1)
    THEN: centre_limit

  # E98: no other centre suits after the first try and one more (the same count as E84, which
  # widens the search once), so the current booking is kept.
  centre_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: centre_search_count <= 2
    ON_FAIL: nothing_suits
    THEN: centre_prep

  centre_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, centre_place, centre_emirate]
    THEN: ask_new_centre

  ask_new_centre:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller wants to move their service booking for the {{vehicle_model}} from
      {{current_centre_name}} to another service centre.
      {{#if centre_none}}No service centre that can take this car was found for "{{centre_none}}". Say so first and ask for another area or the emirate.{{/if}}
      If the line above gives you nothing to say first, and the caller has already said a
      centre or an area in this call that has not been tried, ask nothing and say nothing:
      store it as described below. The next step speaks, and anything you say now would be
      heard after it.
      Otherwise ask which centre or which area they would prefer. If the caller has not yet
      heard which booking this is, start with it in a few words: the car, the day and time,
      and the centre. Do not name centres yourself.
      Store the place in centre_place (and the emirate in centre_emirate only if they say it)
      and set step_outcome to "answered".
      If they decide to leave the booking as it is, set step_outcome to "keep".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: centre_asked

  centre_asked:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [centre_none]
    THEN: centre_route

  centre_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered" AND centre_place IS SET AND centre_place != ""
    ON_FAIL: centre_unnamed
    THEN: find_centres

  # E97: an answer that named no place counts as one of the two tries and is asked for again.
  centre_unnamed:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: centre_count

  # Only centres the booking system returns for this car are offered.
  find_centres:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_service_centres
      WITH:
        area_or_landmark: centre_place
        emirate: centre_emirate
        vehicle_model: vehicle_model
      AS: centre_search
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: centre_search.total > 0
        THEN: centre_offer_prep
      - ELSE:
        THEN: centre_not_found
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_system

  centre_not_found:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      centre_none = centre_place
    THEN: centre_count

  # The centres are copied out of the search result in the turn of the search, for the same
  # reason as the free times.
  centre_offer_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      centre_options = centre_search.centres
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, chosen_centre_id, picked_centre]
    THEN: offer_centre

  offer_centre:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller is choosing a service centre for their booking. They asked for
      "{{centre_place}}". Centres that can take this car, nearest first, live from the booking
      system:
      {{#each centre_options}}
      - {{this.name}}, {{this.area}}, {{this.emirate}}, centre id {{this.centre_id}}
      {{/each}}
      Their booking is now at {{current_centre_name}}.
      If they named one centre and exactly that centre is in the list, do not ask again:
      store its centre id in chosen_centre_id, set step_outcome to "picked" and say nothing.
      Otherwise offer the first centre in the list. Never offer or accept a centre that is not
      in the list, and do not read the list out. Only an answer the caller gives after you
      have offered a centre counts.
      When you make that offer and the caller has not yet heard on this call which booking
      this is, start with it in a few words: the car, the day and time, and the centre. The
      booking: {{vehicle_model}}, {{current_start_label}}.
      - They accept a centre: its centre id in chosen_centre_id and step_outcome "picked".
      - They want a different area: step_outcome "other_place".
      - They would rather leave the booking as it is: step_outcome "keep".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: centre_offer_route

  centre_offer_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "picked" AND chosen_centre_id IS SET AND chosen_centre_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: centre_offer_other
    THEN: centre_pick_eval

  # E97: another area, or "picked" with no centre named: asked again, within the two tries.
  centre_offer_other:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "other_place" OR step_outcome == "picked"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: centre_count

  centre_pick_eval:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      picked_centre = ARRAY_FIND(centre_options, "centre_id", chosen_centre_id)
    THEN: centre_pick_check

  centre_pick_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: picked_centre IS SET
    ON_FAIL: centre_count
    THEN: centre_same_check

  # The same centre is not a change of centre: it is a change of time (E96).
  centre_same_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: picked_centre.centre_id != current_centre_id
    ON_FAIL: time_start
    THEN: centre_pickup_check

  # E97, assumption: a booking with pick-up and drop-off keeps it when it is replaced, so the
  # new centre must be one that offers it. The booking system says which centres do. When the
  # chosen centre does not, nothing is changed and a person helps (A04).
  centre_pickup_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_has_pickup == true
    ON_FAIL: centre_set
    THEN: centre_pickup_offered

  centre_pickup_offered:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: picked_centre.pickup_dropoff == true
    ON_FAIL: escape_centre_pickup
    THEN: centre_set

  # E97: a new centre starts its own count of options (same rule as Q05).
  centre_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      target_centre_id = picked_centre.centre_id
      target_centre_name = picked_centre.name
      centre_move = true
      late_mode = false
      slot_round_count = 0
    THEN: time_today_gate

  # E97: the read-back was confirmed. The new booking carries the contact of the replaced
  # booking and stays on the profile that booking belongs to. The reason for the change and a
  # concern about the car go into the notes; the booking system records the reason code
  # changed_centre itself.
  move_confirmed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = true
      replaced_booking_reference = booking_reference
      replacement_contact_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_booking.contact_name, selected_booking.customer_name, caller_name, customer_name, "Not given")
      replacement_customer_id = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_booking.belongs_to_customer_id, crm_customer_id)
      change_notes = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Moved from __FROM__ by the voice assistant. Reason for the change of centre: __REASON__. Caller concern: __CONCERN__.", "__FROM__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(current_centre_name, "another centre")), "__REASON__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(change_reason_text, "not given")), "__CONCERN__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(concern_note, "none"))
    THEN: move_notes_check

  # E97: notes that are sent again replace the notes of the old booking, so the earlier notes
  # are put in front of what this call adds.
  move_notes_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: selected_booking.notes IS SET AND selected_booking.notes != ""
    ON_FAIL: create_replacement
    THEN: move_notes_merge

  move_notes_merge:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      change_notes = REPLACE(REPLACE("__EARLIER__ __ADDED__", "__EARLIER__", selected_booking.notes), "__ADDED__", change_notes)
    THEN: create_replacement

  # E97, A04: one call replaces the booking. The service code is the one the booking system
  # returned for the replaced booking, never its label; it is empty for a visit that is not a
  # service, and the booking system then keeps what the replaced booking had. A lost slot or an
  # expired hold is searched once more (same rule as E85); any other refusal leaves the old
  # booking as it was and goes to a person.
  create_replacement:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: create_service_booking
      WITH:
        slot_id: picked_slot.slot_id
        plate_number: plate_number
        contact_name: replacement_contact_name
        contact_mobile: replacement_contact_mobile
        service_code: current_service_code
        hold_id: held_hold_id
        replaces_booking_reference: replaced_booking_reference
        customer_id: replacement_customer_id
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
        notes: change_notes
      AS: replacement
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: replacement.booked == true
        THEN: centre_changed
      - IF: replacement.failure_reason == "slot_taken" OR replacement.failure_reason == "hold_expired"
        THEN: update_refused
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          refusal_reason = replacement.failure_reason
        THEN: escape_change_failed
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_move_unknown

  # The new booking has its own reference. It is copied from the result (and from the value
  # the tool publishes) so the confirmation that follows is for the new booking.
  centre_changed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      change_made = true
      centre_move = false
      booking_reference = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(replacement.booking_reference, new_booking_reference)
      current_centre_id = target_centre_id
      current_centre_name = target_centre_name
      current_start_time = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(replacement.start_time, picked_slot.start_time)
      current_start_label = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(replacement.start_label, picked_slot.start_label, replacement.start_time, picked_slot.start_time)
      booking_date = SUBSTRING(FIRST_NON_EMPTY(replacement.start_time, picked_slot.start_time), 0, 10)
    CLEAR: [concern_note, held_hold_id]
    RESPOND: "That's done, your booking is now at {{target_centre_name}}."
    MESSAGE_KEY: centre_change_done
    THEN: sms_prep

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # G. Add a job (P12): added if the booking system allows it, otherwise a person.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  job_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, jobs_to_add, refusal_reason]
    THEN: ask_job

  ask_job:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller wants to add a job to their service booking: {{vehicle_model}},
      {{current_start_label}}, at {{current_centre_name}}.
      Find out what they want added, unless they have already said it. Repeat it back in a
      few words with the day, the time and the centre of the booking, and ask if that is right.
      Only a yes the caller gives after you have repeated it back counts.
      - Yes: store the jobs in jobs_to_add as a list of short English labels, for example
        ["battery check"], and set step_outcome to "confirmed".
      - They change their mind: step_outcome "keep".
      Jobs are added without a price. Do not quote a price or say how long it will take.
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 5
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: job_measure

  job_measure:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      job_count = LENGTH(jobs_to_add)
    THEN: job_route

  job_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "confirmed" AND job_count > 0
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: job_confirmed

  job_confirmed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = true
    THEN: add_job

  # P12, A04: the booking system decides whether the job can be added. When it refuses
  # (job_not_allowed, or any other reason) the call goes to a person; too_late is its cut-off
  # for any change (Q07).
  add_job:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: update_service_booking
      WITH:
        booking_reference: booking_reference
        add_jobs: jobs_to_add
        notes: concern_note
      AS: job_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: job_result.updated == true
        THEN: job_added
      - IF: job_result.failure_reason == "too_late"
        THEN: escape_too_late
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          refusal_reason = job_result.failure_reason
        THEN: escape_job_refused
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_change_unknown

  job_added:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      change_made = true
    CLEAR: [concern_note]
    RESPOND: "That's done, it's added to your booking."
    MESSAGE_KEY: job_added_done
    THEN: sms_prep

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # H. Cancel.
  # OPEN Q06 (contact centre): What are the top reasons people cancel or reschedule?
  # Q06 is also E100. Until the list exists: another date is offered first, then the reason
  # is asked once and recorded in the caller's words with the closest code the booking system has.
  # The booking system sends no message of its own, so the cancellation is confirmed with the
  # cancellation message once the last digits of the number are confirmed (section I).
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  cancel_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, refusal_reason]
    THEN: offer_other_date

  offer_other_date:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller wants to cancel their service booking: {{vehicle_model}},
      {{current_start_label}}, at {{current_centre_name}}.
      Before anything is cancelled, name the booking (the day and date, the time and the
      centre) and offer once to move it to another day instead. Only an answer the caller
      gives after that offer counts.
      - They accept another day: step_outcome "reschedule".
      - They still want to cancel: step_outcome "cancel".
      - They decide to keep it: step_outcome "keep".
      Offer only once and do not argue.
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: retention_route

  retention_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "cancel"
    ON_FAIL: retention_reschedule
    THEN: cancel_reason_prep

  retention_reschedule:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "reschedule"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: retention_switch

  retention_switch:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      requested_action = "reschedule"
    THEN: time_start

  cancel_reason_prep:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, cancel_reason_code, cancel_reason_text]
    THEN: ask_cancel_reason

  ask_cancel_reason:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller has said they still want to cancel their service booking. Ask once, in a few
      words, what the reason is, so that it can be recorded. If they have already given a
      reason in this call, do not ask.
      Store the reason in their own words in cancel_reason_text, and the closest code in
      cancel_reason_code: schedule_conflict, car_not_available, serviced_elsewhere, price,
      booked_twice or other. If they would rather not say, use other and "not given". Then set
      step_outcome to "answered". Never ask a second time.
      If they would now rather keep the booking, set step_outcome to "keep".
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: escape_not_understood
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: open_ended_question
    THEN: cancel_reason_route

  # Only a recorded answer goes on to the cancellation. A change of mind, or an answer that
  # cannot be understood, never cancels anything.
  cancel_reason_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "answered"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt
    THEN: cancel_confirmed

  # The caller said twice that they want to cancel: at the start and after the offer of
  # another date. The reason is recorded even when they would rather not give one.
  cancel_confirmed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      cancel_reason_code = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(cancel_reason_code, "other")
      cancel_reason_text = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(cancel_reason_text, "not given")
      caller_confirmed = true
    THEN: cancel_code_check

  cancel_code_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: cancel_reason_code == "schedule_conflict" OR cancel_reason_code == "car_not_available" OR cancel_reason_code == "serviced_elsewhere" OR cancel_reason_code == "price" OR cancel_reason_code == "booked_twice" OR cancel_reason_code == "other"
    ON_FAIL: cancel_code_other
    THEN: cancel_booking

  cancel_code_other:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      cancel_reason_code = "other"
    THEN: cancel_booking

  # Q07: cancelled also on the day itself; too_late is the booking system's cut-off and goes
  # to a person. A04: cancelled in the booking system. A booking that was already cancelled
  # needs nothing more; any other refusal goes to a person.
  cancel_booking:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: cancel_service_booking
      WITH:
        booking_reference: booking_reference
        reason_code: cancel_reason_code
        reason_text: cancel_reason_text
      AS: cancel_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: cancel_result.cancelled == true
        THEN: cancel_recorded
      - IF: cancel_result.failure_reason == "too_late"
        THEN: escape_too_late
      - IF: cancel_result.failure_reason == "already_cancelled"
        THEN: cancel_already
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          refusal_reason = cancel_result.failure_reason
        THEN: escape_cancel_refused
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: escape_change_unknown

  # Q06: the booking system says the booking was cancelled before this call reached it.
  # Nothing is left to do, and no second message is sent.
  cancel_already:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      booking_open = false
    RESPOND: "This booking has already been cancelled."
    MESSAGE_KEY: booking_already_cancelled
    THEN: finish

  # What the later steps need from the cancellation (whether it was a recall booking, the late
  # fee) is copied out of the tool result here, before any other tool is called.
  cancel_recorded:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      booking_open = false
      cancel_was_recall = cancel_result.was_recall
      late_fee_aed = cancel_result.late_cancel_fee_aed
    THEN: recall_gate

  # OPEN E102 (contact centre): Is this still right? Until answered the recall team is told
  # when a recall booking is cancelled. Set the flag to "false" to stop the notice.
  recall_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: (cancel_was_recall == true OR selected_booking.is_recall == true) AND ("{{env.TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_RECALL_CANCEL_NOTIFY}}" != "false")
    ON_FAIL: fee_check
    THEN: recall_notice_prep

  recall_notice_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      team_mobile = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_booking.contact_mobile, contact_mobile, caller_phone, "not known")
      team_customer_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_booking.customer_name, customer_name, caller_name)
      team_summary = REPLACE(REPLACE("The customer cancelled a recall booking on a call with the voice assistant. Reason given: __REASON__. The recall on the car is still open and the booking at __CENTRE__ is cancelled. No callback was promised.", "__REASON__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(cancel_reason_text, "not given")), "__CENTRE__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(current_centre_name, "the service centre"))
    THEN: notify_recall_team

  # The notice is for the recall team only: nothing is promised to the caller, and a notice
  # that cannot be sent does not hold the call up.
  notify_recall_team:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_team_request
      WITH:
        team: "recall"
        request_type: "recall_cancelled"
        summary: team_summary
        customer_mobile: team_mobile
        centre_id: current_centre_id
        customer_name: team_customer_name
        plate_number: plate_number
        booking_reference: booking_reference
        callback_requested: false
      AS: recall_notice
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: fee_check
    THEN: fee_check

  # Same rule as E75: a chauffeur pick-up cancelled late carries a fee. The amount comes from
  # the booking system, never from this file.
  fee_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: late_fee_aed > 0
    ON_FAIL: cancel_done
    THEN: cancel_done_fee

  cancel_done:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "Your booking is cancelled."
    MESSAGE_KEY: booking_cancelled
    THEN: cancel_sms_prep

  cancel_done_fee:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "Your booking is cancelled. The pick-up was cancelled at short notice, so the late cancellation fee of {{late_fee_aed}} dirhams applies."
    MESSAGE_KEY: booking_cancelled_late_fee
    THEN: cancel_sms_prep

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # I. The message: the confirmation after every change and again on request (E126, E99), and
  # the cancellation message after a cancellation (Q06).
  # The last three digits of the number are confirmed first; another number is accepted.
  # Whether confirmations go by SMS or WhatsApp is still open (Q08, owned by the service
  # booking agent), so no channel is chosen here: the notify service applies its configured
  # default. It does not fall back by itself, so a message that did not go out on WhatsApp is
  # sent once more by SMS.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  sms_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      message_template = "service_booking_confirmation"
      cancel_message = false
      contact_last_digits = SUBSTRING(contact_mobile, MAX(SUB(LENGTH(contact_mobile), 3), 0))
      sms_number_confirmed = false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, new_contact_mobile]
    THEN: confirm_sms_number

  # Q06: the booking no longer exists, so the message is the one that confirms the cancellation.
  cancel_sms_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      message_template = "service_booking_cancellation"
      cancel_message = true
      change_made = false
      contact_last_digits = SUBSTRING(contact_mobile, MAX(SUB(LENGTH(contact_mobile), 3), 0))
      sms_number_confirmed = false
    CLEAR: [step_outcome, new_contact_mobile]
    THEN: confirm_sms_number

  confirm_sms_number:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      A message about the caller's service booking is about to be sent.
      {{#if cancel_message}}The booking has just been cancelled and the caller has been told. The message confirms the cancellation: call it that, and do not read the booking out again. If they now want to book a new service, that is a new request: hand it back with __return_to_parent__.{{/if}}
      {{#if change_made}}The booking has just been changed and the caller has been told. Call it the updated confirmation.{{/if}}
      {{#if booking_open}}The booking: {{vehicle_model}}, {{current_start_label}}, at {{current_centre_name}}. If the caller has not heard it on this call yet, say the day and date, the time and the centre first, so that they have it even if the message does not arrive.{{/if}}
      The number on file ends in {{contact_last_digits}}. Tell the caller the message will go
      to the number ending in those digits, saying only those last digits, and ask if that is
      right. If no digits are shown, ask which mobile number the message should go to.
      Only an answer the caller gives after you have asked this counts.
      - Yes: step_outcome "confirmed".
      - Another number: take it, read it back in groups of three or four digits and wait for a
        yes, store it in new_contact_mobile in international format, for example
        +971501234567, and step_outcome "other_number".
      - They do not want a message: step_outcome "none".
      Also store "ar" in message_language if the caller is speaking Arabic, otherwise "en".
      No email: confirmations go by message only.
      {{#if booking_open}}If they ask for an email, say the message has a link to add the booking to their calendar, reschedule or cancel.{{/if}}
      Always: if the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering
      problem, or being afraid to drive, ask once whether the car is safe to drive; safe and they
      only want it looked at: note it in concern_note and carry on; not safe, unsure or afraid:
      their words in safety_note and step_outcome "safety". Roadside, an accident, an injury, or
      a child or pet locked in the car: step_outcome "safety" at once, ask nothing. Asks for a
      person: two or three sentences in caller_note and step_outcome "person"; asks for a
      manager or a supervisor: the same with step_outcome "manager"; upset or complaining: the
      same with step_outcome "upset".
      {{#if owner_only}}Says the booking is in someone else's name, or that they are calling for the person who booked it: step_outcome "other_name".{{/if}}
      Wants something else done with this booking, or means a different booking: the new action
      in switch_action and step_outcome "switch". Anything that is not about an existing service
      booking: hand it back with __return_to_parent__. After storing an answer, say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [get_local_date_time]
    EXIT_WHEN: step_outcome IS SET
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 5
    ON_EXHAUSTED: sms_skip_route
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: sms_route

  sms_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "confirmed" AND contact_mobile IS SET AND contact_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: sms_other
    THEN: sms_number_ok

  sms_other:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "other_number" AND new_contact_mobile IS SET AND new_contact_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: sms_none
    THEN: sms_number_new

  sms_none:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "none"
    ON_FAIL: sms_interrupt
    THEN: sms_skip_route

  # An answer about the message that cannot be used never undoes or escalates the change:
  # no message is sent and the caller is told so. "Leave it" at this point is about the
  # message, not the booking, which may just have been changed, so it also ends here.
  sms_interrupt:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "safety" OR step_outcome == "person" OR step_outcome == "manager" OR step_outcome == "upset" OR step_outcome == "other_name" OR step_outcome == "switch"
    ON_FAIL: sms_skip_route
    THEN: route_interrupt

  sms_number_ok:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      sms_number_confirmed = true
    THEN: sms_language_check

  sms_number_new:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      contact_mobile = new_contact_mobile
      contact_last_digits = SUBSTRING(new_contact_mobile, MAX(SUB(LENGTH(new_contact_mobile), 3), 0))
      sms_number_confirmed = true
    THEN: sms_language_check

  # The message goes out in the language of the call. Only the two languages it exists in are
  # passed on; anything else is left out and the notify service uses its own default.
  sms_language_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: message_language == "en" OR message_language == "ar"
    ON_FAIL: sms_language_drop
    THEN: send_confirmation

  sms_language_drop:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [message_language]
    THEN: send_confirmation

  # Same rule as Q08: the first send leaves the channel to the notify service. When it reports
  # that the message did not go out and the channel it used was WhatsApp, the message is sent
  # once more by SMS.
  send_confirmation:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_customer_message
      WITH:
        mobile_number: contact_mobile
        template: message_template
        reference: booking_reference
        language: message_language
      AS: sms_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: sms_result.sent == true
        THEN: sms_sent
      - IF: sms_result.channel_used == "whatsapp"
        THEN: send_by_sms
      - ELSE:
        THEN: sms_fail_route
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: sms_fail_route

  send_by_sms:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_customer_message
      WITH:
        mobile_number: contact_mobile
        template: message_template
        channel: "sms"
        reference: booking_reference
        language: message_language
      AS: sms_retry
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: sms_retry.sent == true
        THEN: sms_sent
      - ELSE:
        THEN: sms_fail_route
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: sms_fail_route

  sms_sent:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      sms_number_confirmed = false
    RESPOND: "I've sent the confirmation to the number ending {{contact_last_digits}}."
    MESSAGE_KEY: confirmation_sent
    THEN: finish

  # Same rule as E88: what the caller hears when no message went out depends on whether a
  # booking is left.
  sms_fail_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: cancel_message == true
    ON_FAIL: sms_not_sent
    THEN: cancel_sms_not_sent

  # The read-back is the backup when the message does not go out; it can be sent again.
  sms_not_sent:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      sms_number_confirmed = false
    RESPOND: "I couldn't send the message just now. Your booking is as I read it out, and the message can be sent again whenever you ask."
    MESSAGE_KEY: confirmation_not_sent
    THEN: finish

  cancel_sms_not_sent:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      sms_number_confirmed = false
    RESPOND: "I couldn't send the message just now, but your booking is cancelled."
    MESSAGE_KEY: cancel_message_not_sent
    THEN: finish

  sms_skip_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: cancel_message == true
    ON_FAIL: sms_skipped
    THEN: cancel_sms_skipped

  sms_skipped:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I haven't sent a message. Your booking is as I read it out."
    MESSAGE_KEY: confirmation_skipped
    THEN: finish

  cancel_sms_skipped:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I haven't sent a message. Your booking is cancelled."
    MESSAGE_KEY: cancel_message_skipped
    THEN: finish

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # J. Keep the booking (E98), and the short close when nothing was changed.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  acknowledge:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "All right."
    MESSAGE_KEY: acknowledged
    THEN: finish

  keep_booking:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
    THEN: keep_late_gate

  # OPEN P13 (contact centre): Does the contact centre currently tell the service centre when
  # a customer is running late? Until answered nothing is sent. Set the flag to "true" to send
  # the service centre a notice when a late caller keeps the booking.
  keep_late_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: late_mode == true AND ("{{env.TOYOTA_BOOKING_CHANGE_LATE_NOTIFY_CENTRE}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: keep_said_route
    THEN: late_notice_prep

  late_notice_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      team_mobile = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_booking.contact_mobile, contact_mobile, caller_phone, "not known")
      team_customer_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_booking.customer_name, customer_name, caller_name)
      team_summary = "The customer called to say they are running late for, or missed, this service booking. No other time was taken, so the booking is kept as it is. No callback was promised."
    THEN: notify_centre_late

  notify_centre_late:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_team_request
      WITH:
        team: "service_centre"
        request_type: "customer_running_late"
        summary: team_summary
        customer_mobile: team_mobile
        centre_id: current_centre_id
        customer_name: team_customer_name
        plate_number: plate_number
        booking_reference: booking_reference
        callback_requested: false
      AS: late_notice
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: late_notice.sent == true
        THEN: keep_said_late
      - ELSE:
        THEN: keep_said_route
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: keep_said_route

  # E98: one line either way: the booking stays, with the reason when the options ran out.
  keep_said_route:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: options_ran_out == true
    ON_FAIL: keep_said
    THEN: keep_said_none

  keep_said:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "Your booking stays as it is."
    MESSAGE_KEY: booking_kept
    THEN: finish

  keep_said_none:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I haven't been able to find an option that suits you, so your booking stays as it is."
    MESSAGE_KEY: nothing_suits
    THEN: finish

  keep_said_late:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "Your booking stays as it is, and I've let the service centre know you're running late."
    MESSAGE_KEY: booking_kept_centre_told
    THEN: finish

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # K. Outcomes any reasoning step can raise: safety, a person, a manager, an upset caller, a
  # booking in someone else's name, a change of mind, keep it.
  # Every step's own branches come first; whatever they do not match lands here, and an
  # outcome nobody listed ends with a person.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  route_interrupt:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "safety"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt_person
    THEN: escape_safety

  route_interrupt_person:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "person"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt_manager
    THEN: escape_caller_asked

  # Same rule as A03 (owned by the handover agent): a caller who asks for a manager keeps that
  # reason, so that the handover agent arranges a manager callback and never a transfer to
  # another contact centre agent.
  route_interrupt_manager:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "manager"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt_upset
    THEN: escape_manager_asked

  route_interrupt_upset:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "upset"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt_owner
    THEN: escape_caller_upset

  # OPEN E95 (contact centre): see owner_gate.
  route_interrupt_owner:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "other_name"
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt_switch
    THEN: escape_other_name

  route_interrupt_switch:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "switch" AND switch_action IS SET
    ON_FAIL: route_interrupt_keep
    THEN: do_switch

  # E98: the caller would rather leave the booking as it is. Before a booking has been found
  # there is nothing to keep: a caller who no longer wants to go on gets a short close, not a
  # hand-over to a person.
  route_interrupt_keep:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: step_outcome == "keep" OR step_outcome == "stop"
    ON_FAIL: escape_not_understood
    THEN: keep_open_check

  keep_open_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_open == true
    ON_FAIL: acknowledge
    THEN: keep_booking

  # A change of mind goes back to the step for the new action. Nothing confirmed for the old
  # action carries over. A fourth change of mind in one task goes to a person, so this cannot loop.
  do_switch:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      requested_action = switch_action
      caller_confirmed = false
      switch_count = ADD(switch_count, 1)
    THEN: switch_done

  switch_done:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [switch_action, step_outcome]
    THEN: switch_limit

  switch_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: switch_count <= 3
    ON_FAIL: escape_not_understood
    THEN: switch_guard

  # A change of mind before a booking was found simply carries on with the lookup. It counts
  # against the same limit as "I mean a different booking", so it cannot loop. "Leave it"
  # before a booking was found ends the task with a short close.
  switch_guard:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_open == true
    ON_FAIL: switch_early_keep
    THEN: action_change

  switch_early_keep:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_action != "keep"
    ON_FAIL: acknowledge
    THEN: switch_early

  switch_early:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      restart_count = ADD(restart_count, 1)
    THEN: restart_limit

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # L. Escapes. The reason and the summary are set in the steps before the hand-off step. The
  # hand-off step sets the flag and hands the call over in the same step: the flow never
  # completes with a flag raised, because completing would return the call to the supervisor
  # and the caller would reach nobody. The handover agent does the transfer (or offers a
  # callback, or closes the demo), so the lines here say what happened and promise nothing,
  # the shared system-trouble phrase included. No closing question is asked on an escape: the
  # next agent speaks.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  escape_safety:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      safety_note = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(safety_note, "The caller reported a possible safety problem with the car while changing a service booking.")
    THEN: hand_to_safety

  hand_to_safety:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      safety_flag = true
    DO:
      - HANDOFF: Toyota_Safety_Roadside_Agent

  escape_caller_asked:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "caller_asked"
      handover_detail = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(caller_note, "The caller asked for a person during the booking change.")
    THEN: hand_to_person

  # Same rule as A03: the reason code manager_requested is what the handover agent turns into
  # a manager callback.
  escape_manager_asked:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "manager_requested"
      handover_detail = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(caller_note, "The caller asked for a manager during the booking change.")
    THEN: hand_to_person

  # The handover agent acknowledges an upset caller before the connecting line (E28).
  escape_caller_upset:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "caller_upset"
      handover_detail = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(caller_note, "The caller was upset or complaining during the booking change.")
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_not_understood:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "not_understood"
      handover_detail = "The assistant could not understand the caller after asking again. Please pick up from the caller's last answer."
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, I'm having trouble understanding."
    MESSAGE_KEY: not_understood
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_system:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_system_unavailable"
      handover_detail = "The booking system did not answer after one retry. Nothing was changed in this step."
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with that just now."
    MESSAGE_KEY: system_trouble
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_other_name:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_in_someone_elses_name"
      handover_detail = "The booking is in someone else's name, or the caller is calling for the owner. Nothing was changed. Please confirm who may change it."
    RESPOND: "This booking is in someone else's name, so I can't handle it myself."
    MESSAGE_KEY: other_name_notice
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_plate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "plate_not_captured"
      handover_detail = "The plate number could not be captured after two tries, so the booking was not found."
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, I couldn't get the plate number right."
    MESSAGE_KEY: plate_not_captured
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_not_identified:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_not_identified"
      handover_detail = "The caller has more than one booking, or means a different booking, and the assistant could not work out which one."
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, I couldn't work out which booking you mean."
    MESSAGE_KEY: booking_not_identified
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_not_found:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_not_found"
      handover_detail = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(caller_note, "No booking from today onwards was found by reference, plate and phone, and the caller says a booking exists.")
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_other_change:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "change_not_supported"
      handover_detail = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(caller_note, "The caller wants a change to the booking that the assistant cannot make. Nothing was changed.")
    RESPOND: "That is a change I can't make myself."
    MESSAGE_KEY: change_needs_person
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_confirm_disabled:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_confirmation_request"
      handover_detail = "The caller wants to confirm an existing booking. The assistant is set not to read bookings back."
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_same_day:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "same_day_change"
      handover_detail = "The caller wants to change or cancel a booking on the day of the booking. Nothing was changed."
    RESPOND: "Because the booking is today, I can't change or cancel it myself."
    MESSAGE_KEY: same_day_notice
    THEN: hand_to_person

  # OPEN Q07 (contact centre): see change_allowed_gate. The booking system says the booking
  # can no longer be changed or cancelled: before a change is tried (can_change false), or when
  # it is saved (too_late). Nothing was changed. A04: a person.
  escape_too_late:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      handover_reason = "booking_change_too_late"
      handover_detail = "The booking system says this booking can no longer be changed or cancelled by the assistant. Nothing was changed."
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, I can no longer change or cancel this booking myself."
    MESSAGE_KEY: change_too_late
    THEN: hand_to_person

  # A04: the booking system would not take the change, or the slot was lost twice. Nothing
  # was changed. The reason code the booking system gave, when it gave one, is passed on.
  escape_change_failed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      handover_reason = "booking_change_failed"
      handover_detail = REPLACE("The booking system did not accept the change the caller asked for, or the time was lost twice. Reason code from the booking system: __WHY__. The current booking has not been changed.", "__WHY__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(refusal_reason, "none given"))
    RESPOND: "I wasn't able to make that change. Your current booking has not been changed."
    MESSAGE_KEY: change_not_made
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_change_unknown:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      handover_reason = "booking_change_error"
      handover_detail = "The booking system returned an error while the confirmed change was being saved. Please check the state of the booking before trying again."
    RESPOND: "Something went wrong while I was saving that, so I can't be sure it went through."
    MESSAGE_KEY: change_status_unknown
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_job_refused:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      handover_reason = "job_not_added"
      handover_detail = REPLACE("The booking system did not accept the extra job. Reason code from the booking system: __WHY__. The booking itself has not been changed.", "__WHY__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(refusal_reason, "none given"))
    RESPOND: "I wasn't able to add that to your booking myself. The booking itself has not changed."
    MESSAGE_KEY: job_not_added
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_cancel_refused:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      handover_reason = "cancel_failed"
      handover_detail = REPLACE("The caller confirmed the cancellation and gave a reason, but the booking system did not cancel the booking. Reason code from the booking system: __WHY__.", "__WHY__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(refusal_reason, "none given"))
    RESPOND: "I wasn't able to cancel the booking myself. It has not been cancelled."
    MESSAGE_KEY: cancel_not_made
    THEN: hand_to_person

  # E97: see centre_pickup_check.
  escape_centre_pickup:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "centre_change_with_pickup"
      handover_detail = REPLACE("The booking includes pick-up and drop-off and the caller wants to move it to __NEW__, which the booking system does not show as offering pick-up and drop-off. Nothing was changed.", "__NEW__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(picked_centre.name, "another centre"))
    RESPOND: "This booking includes pick-up and drop-off, which that centre doesn't offer, so moving it needs one of our team."
    MESSAGE_KEY: centre_change_needs_person
    THEN: hand_to_person

  escape_centre_not_ready:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "centre_change_details_missing"
      handover_detail = "The caller wants another centre, but there is no phone number for the person bringing the car, on the booking or on this call. Nothing was changed."
    RESPOND: "I wasn't able to make that change. Your current booking has not been changed."
    MESSAGE_KEY: change_not_made
    THEN: hand_to_person

  # E97: the booking system gave an error while the booking was being replaced, so it is not
  # known whether the change went through. The replacement is one transaction: either the old
  # booking still stands or the new one is in its place. Nothing is tried again here (same rule
  # as N01: never book twice): the caller is told plainly and the person checks first.
  escape_move_unknown:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
      handover_reason = "centre_change_unknown"
      handover_detail = REPLACE(REPLACE("The booking system gave an error while booking __OLD__ was being replaced by a new booking at __NEW__. Either the old booking still stands or the new one has taken its place. The caller has been told. Please check the bookings on this car before trying again.", "__OLD__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(replaced_booking_reference, "unknown")), "__NEW__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(target_centre_name, "the new centre"))
    RESPOND: "Something went wrong while I was moving your booking to {{target_centre_name}}, so I can't be sure it went through."
    MESSAGE_KEY: centre_change_unknown
    THEN: hand_to_person

  # The summary for the person: who the call is about, what the caller wanted, where the
  # booking stands and what is still needed. It is set here, one step before the hand-off, so
  # the hand-over carries it whatever order the two lines of the hand-off step run in.
  # The booking reference travels with the escape as its own field as well.
  hand_to_person:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_queue = "toyota_service"
      handover_summary = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Service booking change call. Customer on file: __WHO__. Car: __CAR__, plate __PLATE__. The caller asked to: __ACTION__. Booking: reference __REF__, centre __CENTRE__, start __WHEN__. __DETAIL__", "__WHO__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(customer_name, caller_name, "not known")), "__CAR__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(vehicle_model, "not known")), "__PLATE__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(plate_number, "not known")), "__ACTION__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(requested_action, "confirm, change or cancel a booking (not narrowed down yet)")), "__REF__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(booking_reference, "not found yet")), "__CENTRE__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(current_centre_name, "not known")), "__WHEN__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(current_start_label, current_start_time, "not known")), "__DETAIL__", FIRST_NON_EMPTY(handover_detail, "No further detail."))
    THEN: hand_to_person_now

  # The escape itself: the flag is set and the hand-off is made in this one step.
  hand_to_person_now:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      needs_person = true
    DO:
      - HANDOFF: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent

  # Task finished. Same rule as E69: a concern about a car that is safe to drive is kept as a
  # note for the centre, so a note that no change carried is appended to the booking here.
  # The append changes nothing the caller has to agree to; the fixed step opens the write gate.
  finish:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_open == true AND concern_note IS SET AND concern_note != ""
    ON_FAIL: finish_clear
    THEN: concern_ready

  concern_ready:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = true
    THEN: save_concern

  save_concern:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: update_service_booking
      WITH:
        booking_reference: booking_reference
        notes: concern_note
      AS: concern_result
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: finish_clear
    THEN: finish_clear

  # The working copy of the booking is dropped, so a second request in the same call starts
  # clean and nothing about this booking stays in memory after the task.
  finish_clear:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      caller_confirmed = false
    CLEAR: [booking_reference, selected_booking, booking_options, booking_open, concern_note, step_outcome, held_hold_id, booking_owner_id]
    THEN: closing

  # Same rule as E22 (one need, then the next): this agent closes its own turn and the
  # supervisor adds nothing after the return. Every path that reaches this step has just told
  # the caller the outcome in a statement, so the shared closing question follows it once.
  # Only the front desk says goodbye.
  closing:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "Is there anything else I can help you with?"
    MESSAGE_KEY: anything_else
    THEN: COMPLETE
